concerns.text: T012-Design depends on T012-Sens, but T012-Sens is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T012-Sens writes `data/analysis/sensitivity_analysis.json` which T012-Design reads. Parallel execution would cause a race condition where T012-Design attempts to read a file that T012-Sens has not yet written. The [P] tag on T012-Sens is incorrect; it must be sequential.

T001.1 (Verify Plan Update) depends on T012-Design. However, T012-Design is described as updating `plan.md` *if* power is sufficient. If power is insufficient, T012-Design sets a flag and triggers T012-Runtime to halt, potentially skipping the plan update. T001.1 assumes the update happened. The dependency chain is fragile: T001.1 should depend on the *outcome* of the power gate (T012-Runtime success), not just the calculation task, to ensure the plan is actually updated before verification.

T096 (Update Plan) depends on T093, T094, T095. T095 depends on T035 (ANOVA). T035 depends on T012-Runtime (Gate). However, T096 requires updating `plan.md` to include specific phrases. If T012-Runtime fails (power insufficient), the pipeline halts, and T035 never runs. Consequently, T095 never runs, and T096 is blocked. Yet, the 'Ladder of Explanation' gap documentation (T093-T098) is a *planning* response to a review, not a *result* of the analysis. These tasks should not depend on the successful completion of the ANOVA (T035); they should be independent of the data collection results and depend only on the scope definition (T060) and the review requirement itself.

T017 (Stimulus Metadata Generation) depends on T006.3-Select and T006.3-Retry. T006.3-Select outputs to `data/stimuli/raw/`. T017 reads from `data/stimuli/raw/` to generate metadata. However, T017 also depends on T015.1-LogParams (Asset Generation Log). The task description says T017 reads `data/assets/generation_log.json` (from T015.1-LogParams) to include asset parameters. This implies T017 generates metadata for *manipulated* images, but the task title says 'Stimulus Metadata Generation' for 'baseline images' (per T017 description: 'generate metadata files for each baseline image'). If T017 is for baseline images, it should not depend on T015.1 (asset generation for manipulation). If it is for manipulated images, the dependency on T015 (manipulation) is missing. The artifact flow is ambiguous: does T017 produce metadata for raw images (pre-manipulation) or final images (post-manipulation)? The current dependencies suggest a mix that breaks the flow.

T006.3-Select and T006.3-Retry are split tasks. T006.3-Select fails if Q1-Q3 range is not met. T006.3-Retry handles the retry. The dependency T006.3-Retry -> T006.3-Select is correct. However, T017 depends on *both*. If T006.3-Select fails initially, T006.3-Retry runs. If T006.3-Retry succeeds, T017 can run. But if T006.3-Select succeeds on the first try, T006.3-Retry is skipped. T017 depending on T006.3-Retry (which might not run) is a logical error. T017 should depend on the *completion* of the selection process (either T006.3-Select success or T006.3-Retry success), not the specific retry task.
